skill.name: raffle-winner-picker
skill.description: Picks random winners from lists, spreadsheets, and Google Sheets for giveaways, raffles, contests, and team assignments.
skill.summary: Select fair random winners from lists, files, or sheets with clear selection details.
skill.author: davila7

content.value_statement: Raffle and giveaway organizers need a clear way to select winners without bias. This skill guides random selection from lists, files, and sheets with transparent results.
actual_capabilities: Selects one or more random winners from plain lists, CSV files, Excel files, or Google Sheets.
Supports exclusions so previous winners or ineligible entries are not selected again.
Handles weighted selection when an entries column represents multiple chances.
Produces winner details with the selected row, timestamp, and selection method.
Can select runner-ups or split participants into random teams.
Encourages transparent records for verification and public announcements.
limitations: It depends on the host assistant or connected tools to read spreadsheets and Google Sheets.
It does not verify legal contest compliance or participant eligibility by itself.
It cannot guarantee data quality when source lists contain duplicate or incomplete entries.
Repeatable seeded selection requires the assistant to expose or preserve the seed.

use_cases.title: Run a Subscriber Giveaway
use_cases.description: Pick one winner and several runner-ups from a subscriber list while recording the selection details.

use_cases.title: Select Event Raffle Winners
use_cases.description: Choose multiple winners from an attendee CSV and exclude anyone who has already won a prize.

use_cases.title: Assign Random Teams
use_cases.description: Split a participant list into balanced random groups for workshops, studies, or testing sessions.

prompt_templates.title: Pick One Winner
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner raffle from a pasted list
prompt_templates.prompt: Pick one random winner from this list. Show the selected name, selection method, and timestamp.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Multiple Winners
prompt_templates.prompt: Pick five random winners from entries.csv. Do not select the same person twice. Include row numbers and a timestamp.

prompt_templates.title: Exclude Prior Winners
prompt_templates.prompt: Pick one winner and three runner-ups from this sheet. Exclude the previous winners named Alice, Bob, and Carol.

prompt_templates.title: Run Weighted Selection
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced raffle with multiple entries per person
prompt_templates.prompt: Pick winners using the entries column as ticket weight. Explain how weights were applied and list any excluded records.

output_examples.input: Pick one winner from a Google Sheet of giveaway entries.
output_examples.output: Winner selected: Sarah Johnson from row 142. Selection used secure random choice, included 247 eligible entries, and recorded a UTC timestamp.

output_examples.input: Pick three winners from an event attendee CSV and avoid duplicates.
output: All selected rows were unique and previous winners were excluded.

output_examples.input: Split twelve participants into three random teams.
output_examples.output: Created three teams with four participants each. The result includes team rosters and the timestamp used for the assignment record.

best_practices: Clean the entry list before selection so duplicate or ineligible records are removed.
Save the timestamp, source size, exclusions, and selection method for audit records.
Pick runner-ups during the same session in case a winner cannot accept the prize.
anti_patterns: Do not change the entry list after seeing the selected winner.
Do not paste private participant data unless the assistant environment is approved for that data.
Do not use weighted selection unless the entry weights are defined before the drawing.

faq.question: Can this skill pick from Google Sheets?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide selection from Google Sheets when the assistant has access to read the sheet.

faq.question: Can it pick more than one winner?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports multiple winners and can avoid selecting the same person twice.

faq.question: Does it support runner-ups?
faq.answer: Yes. It can pick runner-ups after the main winner selection.

faq.question: Can previous winners be excluded?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the exclusion list before selection so those entries are removed first.

faq.question: Does it prove the raffle was fair?
faq.answer: It records the method, timestamp, and entry count. Legal or third-party verification still requires your own process.

faq.question: Can it handle weighted entries?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use a column such as entries or tickets to apply weighted probability.
